newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Yabeng cautions shareholders on talks.
newsitem.headline: Yabeng cautions shareholders on talks.

text.p: Yabeng Investment Holding Co Ltd on Wednesday urged shareholders to continue exercising caution in their dealings after Bophirima Investment Holdings Ltd consortium said it would buy a stake in Yabeng.
The North West Development Corporation Ltd said on Wednesday Bophirima would buy its 40.2 percent stake in Yabeng subject to a condition precedent.
Yabeng also referred shareholders to an earlier cautionery that it was in talks with Choice Holdings Ltd which could impact on its share price.
It said further annoucements would be made.
Yabeng holds 39.12 percent of the Choice preference share capital, an effective 19.56 percent of Choice's issued share capital.
